luf.source: Author judgment informed by Lopez et al. (2012), Ong et al. (2013), Turkovska et al. (2024); docs/thesis/methods/group1_technical_potential.tex tab:g1_luf
luf.note: Residual land-utilization factor (M-F5-01): restrictive / central / permissive paired with the F3 land scenarios, not sampled (U-06).

power_density_mw_per_km2.source: Geometric from IEA 3.4-130 (3.37 MW, rotor 129.82 m; Bortolotti et al. 2019) with spacing 6Dx10D / 5Dx8D / 4Dx7D (Lopez et al. 2012; Harrison-Atlas et al. 2022); docs/thesis/methods/group1_technical_potential.tex
power_density_mw_per_km2.note: Recomputed with the turbine data: 3.333 / 4.999 / 7.141 MW/km2 with D = 129.82 m, 3.324 / 4.985 / 7.122 with D = 130 m; both within 1 percent of the .tex values, which are kept (docs/phases/F5/groups1-2_implementation_report.md). Scenario-coupled, not sampled.

eta_loss.source: Author judgment, component losses after Lee and Fields (2021); docs/thesis/methods/group1_technical_potential.tex tab:g1_wind_losses

range.source: docs/thesis/methods/group1_technical_potential.tex tab:g1_wind_losses

eta_loss.note: Retention factor: CF = eta_loss x integral (0.866 = 1 - 13.4 percent losses). Same in the three countries.

hub_height_m.source: GWA layer nearest to the 110 m hub of IEA 3.4-130; docs/thesis/methods/group1_technical_potential.tex subsec:g1_turbine
hub_height_m.note: The 10 m difference is not corrected. The 150 m layer is run once per country in the reference climate as a sensitivity (hub_height_m = 150).

degradation_rate.note: Annual energy degradation d of M-F6-01, E_t = E_m (1-d)^(t-1). No value yet: pending OQ-019.

grid_cost_usd_per_mw_km.note: Transmission connection cost per MW and km of M-F6-01 (L-019). No value yet: pending OQ-001.

substation_cost_usd_per_mw.note: Substation / point-of-interconnection cost per MW of M-F6-01. No value yet: pending OQ-001.

road_cost_usd_per_km.note: Road access cost per km of M-F6-01. No value yet: pending OQ-001.

cf_min.note: Minimum capacity factor of a feasible cell-member (M-F7-01). No value yet: pending OQ-008.

tau_lcoe_usd_per_mwh.note: Satisficing LCOE threshold, also the cost threshold of the economic potential (M-F7-04, T-R12, H5), constant 2024 USD (S-07). No value yet: pending OQ-008.

top_k_percent.note: Share of the F7 set, by count, that forms the top-k (M-F7-05), 0 < p_k <= 100. No value yet: pending OQ-021.

commissioning_year.note: Technology vintage. Costs of the 2024 IRENA cohort stand for it (no 2026 cohort exists). Documentation only: the kernel reads no year.

range.source: Test range (A-06), not a sourced range; it brackets the test value so the sampler has a span to draw from.

capex_usd_per_kw.note: Test value: round CAPEX chosen so the annualized fixed cost (CRF x CAPEX, see hand-check in docs/phases/core.md D-core-018) is a clean number, not a sourced cost estimate for any real technology or country.

opex_fixed_frac.note: Test value: round 5% O&M, chosen for a hand-computable annualized fixed cost, not a sourced O&M figure.

opex_var_usd_per_mwh.note: Test value: 2 USD/MWh, nonzero so the variable-O&M term of M-F6-01 is exercised by the synthetic F6 run. Not a claim about any real technology.
